rationale: The workflow already implements pip dependency caching via actions/setup-python's cache: pip parameter in both the checks and tests-default jobs, which satisfies the P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE optimization (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2). The tests-default job uses a matrix strategy, and GitHub Actions defaults fail-fast to true, so the P-LIT-FAIL-FAST optimization (experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997, experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242) is already in effect without an explicit change. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) cannot be safely applied because there is no representative successful-duration history available to set a timeout that would not interrupt valid slow runs. No other evidence-supported optimization fits this workflow without risking coverage loss or requiring unsupported assumptions.
